question: List all singer names in concerts in year 2014.
schema_links: Schema_links: [singer.Name, concert.Year, singer.Singer_ID = singer_in_concert.Singer_ID, singer_in_concert.concert_ID = concert.concert_ID]
classification_result:
Reason: Need to join singer, singer_in_concert, and concert to match singers to concerts in 2014. No nested query is required.
Label: NON-NESTED
Sub_questions: []
generated_sql:
SELECT singer.Name
FROM singer
JOIN singer_in_concert ON singer.Singer_ID = singer_in_concert.Singer_ID
JOIN concert ON singer_in_concert.concert_ID = concert.concert_ID
WHERE concert.Year = 2014
